label: Ruled out a new parent-level document: acceptance criteria have no why slot and any new required parent file breaks the lean trio and forces a 297-parent migration.
Ruled out an improved parent template alone: the template already requires root purpose, but parents are exempt from anchors, stamped v2.2, and filled with a generic create.sh sentence.
Ruled out handover.md as the carrier: its template has no purpose slot and 71 of 96 real handovers never mention purpose, problem, objective or user need.
Ruled out the continuity block as it stands: it occurs in 2857 of 2870 summaries but its schema is action-and-state only and the save target has no purpose heading.
Ruled out the compaction Goal facet as a purpose path: buildContinuityFacets fills the goal facet from next_safe_action, so the injected Goal is an action.
Ruled out /speckit:resume as it stands: its resume packet has no purpose slot and the workflow contradicts itself on whether spec.md is read.
Ruled out the relaunch note as compensation: it is gitignored runtime state, no notes existed to sample, and validate.sh never sees it.
Ruled out goal.md as the general carrier: 889 of 2912 spec folders carry one, 884 have a real Objective, and objective-versus-purpose overlap has a median of 0.256 with 132 of 854 pairs below 0.10.

Ruled out a validator-only fix: ANCHORS_VALID grades presence, PLACEHOLDER_FILLED grades tokens, neither grades meaning, and fail-closed enforcement would fail 80 existing parents unless grandfathered.

User need is absent even where purpose is written: 333 of 2866 purposes and 623 of 2884 problem statements mention a beneficiary, so any carried value must include the problem statement or the who is lost.

The continuity-field recommendation survives stress testing with a leaf-to-ancestor fallback, an explicit unset marker, an optional field and the parent authoring fix; no ubiquitous already-read surface was found that would overturn it.
